</title>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Howl of the Wild](/Sources.aspx?ID=226) pg. 118

**Price** 21 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** held in 1 hand

**Bulk** L
</row>

<row gap="medium">
<row gap="tiny"><row>**Activate**</row><row>[Cast a Spell](/Actions.aspx?ID=2734)</row></row>

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

Hardened clumps of _amphisbaena spittle_ can be harvested from the [dual-headed snake's](/Monsters.aspx?ID=1060) hunting grounds. When a casting of [_web of eyes_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1032) is empowered with this catalyst, you can place an additional scrying sensor on the back of each target's head, in the shape of a closed snake's eye. When a target shares their vision with the others affected by the spell, the eye blinks open, preventing the target from being [flanked](/Rules.aspx?ID=2375) until the start of its next turn.

<column gap="tiny">

</column>
